user_reviews.Name: Tati Silva
user_reviews.Description:
I’m in Manchester for the BPS Annual Conference, and what better way to start the day than treating myself to a great brunch? Ezra & Gil did not disappoint.

They don’t take reservations, so I joined a small queue, but I was seated surprisingly quickly, which was a great start.

I ordered a chai latte and the Nduja scrambled eggs absolutely delicious! If you’re someone who enjoys a bit of spice, this dish is for you. It has just the right kick without overpowering the flavours.

Then came the moment of weakness… 😄 I simply couldn’t resist ordering the French Toast of the Day – Apple Crumble. And I’m so glad I did! It was indulgent, comforting, and every bite was worth it.

The service was efficient, and the staff were genuinely lovely and welcoming, creating a relaxed atmosphere that makes you want to stay a little longer.

If you’re in Manchester and looking for a brunch spot that goes beyond the usual avocado toast, Ezra & Gil is absolutely worth a visit. I’ll definitely be back the next time I’m in the city. ☕🍎✨

user_reviews.Name: Rudolf Reih
user_reviews.Description:
I visited the KFC branch at Stretford - Chester Road, Manchester, while I was on the road, tired, a bit rushed, and simply looking for somewhere to have lunch and reset for a moment.

I visit KFC from time to time, so I have a reasonable idea of what the usual service experience looks like. This visit, however, genuinely stood out from many others.

The reason was a member of staff called Danny.

Danny was absolutely fantastic. Polite, attentive, calm, friendly and clearly someone who understands what proper service means, even in a busy fast-food restaurant environment. He seemed to be everywhere at once - helping with the drive-thru, checking on customers, bringing orders over, apologising politely for a small delay, and doing all of it with a genuine smile.

It was not just that the food arrived. It was the way the whole interaction was handled. I actually felt looked after as a customer, which is not something you can always say in a quick-service restaurant.

What impressed me most was how natural it all felt. There are probably hundreds of pages written in service manuals about customer care, customer experience and how fast-food restaurants should treat people. In reality, people who deliver that standard naturally are rare. Danny is one of those people.

As someone who has worked for many years in customer support and operations, and who now works in production and support management for a large technology company, I can say with confidence that people like Danny are the backbone of a business! They are the people customers remember.

This branch is genuinely lucky to have him. People with this kind of natural customer focus, calmness under pressure and ability to make customers feel looked after are not easy to find. In my experience, these are exactly the sort of people who can grow into outstanding managers, because they already understand the most important part of the business - the customer experience.

If KFC has any internal development or promotion plans, Danny should be firmly on that radar. And slightly tongue-in-cheek, but also quite seriously - I would not wait too long before recognising his potential, because people like this do not stay unnoticed forever.

A genuinely excellent visit. Thank you, Danny!!

I hope this feedback is taken constructively and helps ensure that future customers receive the correct portions as advertised. It would be appreciated if this could be reviewed internally so similar situations can be avoided going forward.
